name: ILP-Style State Assignment Formulation
description: Transforms the graph-theoretic Steiner tree objective into a binary state assignment problem (choosing x_i in {0,1} to minimize sum w_i x_i subject to pairwise reachability). This strips away graph-algorithm affordances like "subtree", "pruning", or "leaves", forcing the model to re-derive the tree-pruning logic from first principles of the connectivity constraint.
